Is it the anthem?

Because beer and burger stands don't shut down during the anthem.

The anthem is rarely televised.

People don't stand in their living rooms during the anthem, do they?

#BlackLivesMatter

So it isn't the kneeling.

It certainly isn't the anthem.

Well the only thing we have left is that it's black people.  

When you're trying to police a kneeling protest it isn't about political correctness or respect... it's oppression.  Just own it.

#BlackLivesMatter
